none: PAS LIN-6773B1: Copper alloy Roman TOT ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy finger ring, Henig type XI. The ring has a broad flat bezel with tapering D-shaped hoop. The bezel is decorated with a double rectilinear border, containing the letters TOT. The letters are very worn. Finger rings with the letters ‘TOT’ inscribed on the bezel are a distinctive group with a distribution very much centred on the county of Lincolnshire, although stray finds are known…
